CORRECTION_20260813_the_tool_was_looking.WHY_THIS_WAS_SERIOUS_rather_than_a_typo: A missing file at an inferred path is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a stage that has not run. The reconciler would have reported trainings_present: 0 and verdict PARTIAL *permanently* -- including at a genuine 50/50 -- so the family could never have been promoted, and the failure mode is a confident-looking correct-format report rather than an error.
CORRECTION_20260813_the_tool_was_looking.the_verdict_was_ACCIDENTALLY_RIGHT: At the time of the first run the reported '0 of 50 training receipts' was CORRECT, because no training had finished and the training directories contained no files at all. So the number was right while the instrument was broken -- which is exactly why it was not caught by the result looking wrong.
CORRECTION_20260813_the_tool_was_looking.how_it_was_caught: Not by a failure. By deliberately checking a path I had INFERRED rather than measured, on the standing rule that an absence verdict is a statement about the SEARCH before it is a statement about the world (BEN-086). The check was one `grep` against the launcher.
CORRECTION_20260813_the_tool_was_looking.the_fix_is_a_guard_not_just_a_rename: Both names are now module constants pinned by a test to the launcher's values, and if a receipt-like or artifact-like file exists under an UNEXPECTED name the reconciler returns state NAME_MISMATCH and the family verdict is BLOCK -- never 'absent'. A search whose reliability is in question must stop the tool, because every other count in the report is then a statement about the search.
CORRECTION_20260813_the_tool_was_looking.tests: 56 tests now (was 50). The six new ones cover: the names matching the launcher; an unexpected receipt name; an unexpected artifact name; NAME_MISMATCH blocking the family even with nothing else present; the guard staying SILENT on correctly-named files (power test -- a guard that fires on clean runs gets switched off); and genuine absence still reading as NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS.

WHAT_PASSED_THAT_WAS_NOT_PREVIOUSLY_CHEC.headline: All THREE coherent Poisson factor streams re-drawn from the declared seed and declared full inventory sizes, hashed under the receipts' own stated contract, and compared. 16/16 MATCH on all three.

why_this_is_new_evidence.signal_and_background_were_already_cover: build_fullevent_replica_target.py:219-222 array-compares the loader's signal (restricted to mc_indices) and background factors against a canonical replay and raises SystemExit on mismatch; train_fullevent_replica.py validate_artifact independently re-hashes the persisted full signal factor, asserts its length equals n_sig_full, asserts the subset is a true restriction of the full factor, and re-hashes the background factor. Both stages fail closed.
why_this_is_new_evidence.the_DATA_stream_was_covered_NOWHERE: The loader's bootstrap telemetry dict (fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:1328-1330) exposes mc_indices, sig_bootstrap_factor and bkg_bootstrap_factor and NO data equivalent. So the target stage cannot array-compare data factors (it is not omission by choice -- the value is not exposed), and the training stage cannot re-hash them (they are not persisted). The receipt's data_factor_sha256 is the BUILDER'S OWN recomputation, not a record of what the loader used.
why_this_is_new_evidence.why_that_stream_is_the_one_that_matters: The data factors are what generate the measured-side Poisson variance that C_stat exists to quantify. The single unverified stream was the physically dominant one.
why_this_is_new_evidence.and_the_streams_are_INDEPENDENT_so_the_o: coherent_bootstrap_factors draws data at rng(seed), signal at rng(seed+10_000_000), background at rng(seed+20_000_000). A passing signal check proves (seed, n_sig); a passing background check proves (seed, n_bkg). Neither constrains n_data. That is the actual gap, and it is narrow, not zero.

how_this_run_closes_it: The re-drawn data-factor hash equals the recorded data_factor_sha256 for all 16 replicas -- so the recorded hash IS the canonical draw for the declared (seed, n_data).

n_data is pinned independently: the builder's bootstrap.n_data_full == the loader's own runtime_target.n_data_rows in every receipt (4,116,128), and the loader hard-raises at fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:950 if data_factor.shape != (n_data_rows,).

RESIDUAL, stated rather than dissolved: this proves the recorded hash is canonical, NOT that the loader used it. Only loader-side persistence of the data factor could prove that. The cheap fix for the next launch is one key in the telemetry dict.
WHAT_PASSED_THAT_WAS_NOT_PREVIOUSLY_CHEC.MY_OWN_TOOL_HAD_A_CONTROL_AND_IT_PASSED: numpy 2.3.5 here vs the TF-2.15 module's numpy on the compute nodes. If the PCG64/poisson stream differed between them, ALL THREE redraws would mismatch. Signal and background are independently verified upstream, so their agreement proves my interpreter reproduces the campaign's stream -- which is what makes the data-factor comparison meaningful instead of a coin flip. Had only the data stream mismatched, that would have been a campaign finding; had all three mismatched, it would have been a finding about MY interpreter and nothing else.

DOES_BEN_150_TOUCH_THE_ADOPTED_R.THE_DEFECT_IS_DORMANT_ON_THE_NOMINAL_AND: This is the part worth keeping. The field names were harmless for as long as nothing was scaled; the replica path introduced a scaled variant and activated a LATENT naming defect. The collision did not exist when the names were chosen, so no review of the nominal path could have caught it -- and a latent name collision is invisible until a second variant of the quantity appears.

THE_READING_WAS_TESTED_AS_A_FALSIFIABLE_.prediction: If the outer field is the replica-SCALED sum and the nested `_raw` is genuinely unscaled, the nested `_raw` must be CONSTANT across every replica and EQUAL to the nominal's value, while the outer must vary per replica.
THE_READING_WAS_TESTED_AS_A_FALSIFIABLE_.verdict: All three predictions confirmed. The nested `_raw` is a property of the MC -- sum(w_reco[pass_reco]) before any replica scaling -- so it is identical across replicas and identical to the nominal. Confirmed, not assumed.
